blocks.title: Where CXMT is
blocks.text: HBM3 8-high yield ~25% in 2026Q2 (front-end ~35% x back-end ~70%, SemiAnalysis). HBM3E small-scale production started around Aug 2026, with Reuters putting yield at 20-30% (source notes: ~70% at SK hynix). Full HBM3E mass production: end-2026 (Reuters) or 2027 (Korean industry analysis).
